definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん}. Pre-prepared food that is frozen for preservation and convenience.

examples.japanese: {冷食|れいしょく}をストックしておく。
examples.english: To keep frozen food stocked up.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{冷食|れいしょく}はとても{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Frozen food nowadays is really delicious.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しい{日|ひ}は{冷食|れいしょく}をレンジで{温|あたた}めて{食|た}べることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: On busy days, I often heat up frozen food in the microwave.

notes:
{冷食|れいしょく} is an abbreviation of {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん} (frozen food products). It is composed of {冷|れい} (cold, frozen) + {食|しょく} (food).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷食|れいしょく}コーナー: frozen food section (in a store)
- {冷食|れいしょく}を{温|あたた}める: to heat up frozen food
- {冷食|れいしょく}の{品揃|しなぞろ}え: frozen food selection

USAGE: A casual, everyday abbreviation. The full form {冷凍食品|れいとうしょくひん} is used in more formal contexts such as product labeling and news reports. Japanese frozen food quality is notably high, and the category includes items like {餃子|ぎょうざ}, fried rice, and bento items.
